# Tool changelog (step2-v1)

- 2026-11-02 initial tools: common, preflight, make_batches, view, build.
- 2026-11-02 view.py: display trimmed (occ list <=3, only APPARENT_CONFLICT/UNRESOLVED queue relations, shorter T/E); reading aid only, no effect on outputs.
- 2026-11-02 common.loading_context: detects files @imported by the root CLAUDE.md (always loaded). Applied from M B020 on; no earlier checkpointed batch anchored on such a file in M (verified by scan below).
- 2026-11-02 build.py: evidence_refs ordered anchor-first and new field primary_anchor (defect found by M semantic challenge: first ref could be an overbroad Step-1 occurrence). M B001-B020 rebuilt with --rebuild from unchanged decision files (logged in CHECKPOINTS/REBUILD_LOG.jsonl); calibration recompiled.
- 2026-11-02 Addendum A1 (M independent review): build.py adds sr= strength-resolution codes and strict build checks for batches after M (a strength mismatch needs st= or sr=; a normative record without a reported trigger needs t:); unknown trigger values are no longer reported as attributed text. New tools: corrections.py (overlay with before/after ledger), enrich.py (strength axes, source-quote verification). Checkpointed M batches are not recompiled; M fixes go through _decisions/M/CORRECTIONS.dec.
- 2026-11-02 prior.py (new, from L0 on): reviewer aid that prints how finished earlier candidates classified near-identical text. A hint for reading consistency only; it writes nothing and is not a strictness comparison. Every decision still comes from reading the source in view.py.
- 2026-11-02 candidate.py coverage: new strength_status STRONGER_AND_WEAKER_EVIDENCE when a policy has no equal-strength link but has both stronger and weaker ones. Before this, K0's API-014 and API-019 read ONLY_WEAKER_EVIDENCE although stronger links exist. M, M1, L0 and L1 have 196 EQUIVALENT_EVIDENCE_PRESENT rows, so their outputs do not change.
- 2026-11-03 a13_audit.py (new): end-of-run scan for MUST or MUST_NOT on knowledge-skill and private-reference text with no must-like word anywhere in the evidence. Reads only; --write stores _decisions/A13_AUDIT_FINDINGS.jsonl. Its findings went through CORRECTIONS.dec under AUDIT-A1-KNOWLEDGE with before/after records; batch files were not touched. For M, later lines in STRENGTH.dec replace earlier ones for the same key.
- 2026-11-03 finalize.py (new): global aggregator and validator. candidate.py challenge: --only limits a new round to one family, and the NN pool falls back to all NN records when none is HIGH (PI-013). Round-1 samples are frozen and do not change.
